mission.title: argo-rollouts: Job Analysis Run never fails when the job image can't be pulled (it just succeeds and promotes).
mission.description: Job Analysis Run never fails when the job image can't be pulled (it just succeeds and promotes).. This issue affects 22+ users.

steps.title: Identify argo-rollouts troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your argo-rollouts deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo-rollouts -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-rollouts
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-rollouts -n argo-rollouts --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review argo-rollouts configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant argo-rollouts configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n argo-rollouts -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-rollouts
kubectl get configmap -n argo-rollouts -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo-rollouts
```
Checklist:

Analysis Run of type job never fails when the job image can't be pulled (it just succeeds and promotes). When Job pods can't pull image it goes into `ErrImagePull` indefinitely and the job itself does not Fail.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Job Analysis Run never fails when the job image can't be…
steps.description:
This is the first part of an effort to revamp how Job metrics work in Argo Rollouts. Currently the job metric is very limited and doesn't have the capabilities of the other providers for successConditions and failure conditions. More details at
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: test-deployment
  namespace: test-namespace
spec:
  replicas: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.9.8 # update it to 1.19.0 to trigger a rollout, as the first time will only create the pods.
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-stable
  namespace: test-namespace
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
  - port: 80
    target
```

steps.title: Confirm Job Analysis Run never fails when the job image… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-rollouts -n argo-rollouts --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n argo-rollouts --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary:
This is the first part of an effort to revamp how Job metrics work in Argo Rollouts. Currently the job metric is very limited and doesn't have the capabilities of the other providers for successConditions and failure conditions. More details at https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/issues/2250

This PR makes a job that is terminated to report as inconclusive instead of successful.
